name: TOOL
description: A plugin offering tools the model can call: one tool for each of its actions that carries a `tool` block. A tool's name, description and argument schema are NOT declared here — they live in that `tool` block, the manifest being the single source of truth (see docs/SPI.md). This contract fixes only what every tool has in common: the result an action offered as a tool returns, `#/$defs/Result` — text, or text and image blocks in order — including how a tool says its output was cut (`truncated`, rendered into `content` for the model by the caller, never by the tool). No action is required. `call` is the name a plugin offering one tool conventionally gives its action; a plugin may offer tools from actions of any name.

call.description: Execute a tool once with model-supplied arguments. Every action offered as a tool takes this input and returns this output, whatever it is named.

input.description: The arguments of one tool call, shaped by the implementing action's own `tool.parameters` schema — which is why this contract cannot close the object. Gwead validates no payloads at dispatch; the caller is responsible for checking model-emitted arguments against the declared schema before dispatching.

Result.description: What an action offered as a tool returns.

content.description: The tool result as the model will see it: a string, or a non-empty list of text and image blocks in the order the model should see them. An inline image's bytes are the format its `media_type` names; the caller checks that, and the size, before passing the result on, and answers the call as a failure when they do not hold.

is_error.description: True when `content` describes a failure the model should react to (file not found, command failed). Infrastructure failures are step errors, not `is_error` results.

truncated.description: True when `content` is a prefix of what the tool would otherwise have returned — a capped file read, capped process output, the first of several images. Data, not prose: the tool never appends a marker to `content` itself. The caller renders the one shared marker (`gwennol_core::spi::tool::TRUNCATED_MARKER`) before the model sees the result: on its own final line of a string, or as a text block of its own after the last block of a list, so every tool signals a cut the same way and no tool has to compose it declaratively.

ImageBlock.description: An image in a tool's result, in its position among the result's blocks. `source.type` says how the image travels: its bytes inline, or a reference the provider resolves.

data.description: The file's bytes in standard padded base64 (RFC 4648 section 4).

ReferenceImageSource.description: An image named by a reference in place of its bytes. The caller stores and passes on the reference unchanged and never interprets it; resolving it is the provider's. `media_type` is declared by the tool.

reference.description: Chosen by the embedder: a path, a storage key.

ImageMediaType.description: The image formats this contract names.
